subject: Tramlines Media trial - request temporary invoice routing (no PO)
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@tramlines.media>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — pilot onboarding and invoice routing

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Tramlines is excited to spin up the 3-week trial. We estimate ~120k tokens/week (roughly $12k total) for the initial run.

Our procurement team typically does POs, but for short pilots they can route on invoice only. Can Redwood accommodate a temporary invoice-only path so we can start this week? We can sign your MPA and complete the vendor form immediately; procurement has asked for an audit trail and an exception approval if possible.

Attaching the completed vendor intake form (tramlines_supplier_onboarding_form.pdf). Happy to loop finance if you need additional info.

Best,
Alex Gomez
Head of Platform Partnerships
Tramlines Media

Attachment: tramlines_supplier_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf)

Karthik / Marissa — forwarding Tramlines' request. Short pilot (est $12k) and they've already completed our vendor form and are willing to sign the MPA via DocuSign. Procurement asked for an exception path for invoice-only routing to get them started this week.

Questions: 1) Can procurement issue a conditional exception for pilots under $25k where MPA is signed and evidence stored in the vendor file? 2) What evidence/counterparty checks do you need from Tramlines?

Alex — looping procurement and ops to see what a safe temporary path looks like.

Thanks,

Subject: RE: Fwd: Quick ask — pilot onboarding and invoice routing

Priya / Marissa,

Thanks for the context. We can support a temporary invoice-only path for pilots, but need to lock a few controls before we approve:  

- Signed MPA or equivalent legal cover (DocuSign link)  
- Completed vendor onboarding form (we have the PDF)  
- Evidence of identity (company registration / tax id) or existing vendor profile in our system  
- A hard cap of $25k or 30 days for invoice-only pilots; beyond that we require a PO or prepayment.

If Tramlines signs the MPA and provides registration/tax ID, I can sign an internal exception memo that authorizes Finance to accept invoices without a PO for this pilot. Please note this exception will be recorded on the vendor file and is only valid for the pilot scope.

Marissa — can you confirm the DocuSign envelope status and whether Finance needs any additional fields on the invoice (e.g., department code) to route without a PO?

Karthik
Director, Procurement
Redwood Inference

Attachment: procurement_exception_template.docx (referenced)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

All — quick update and next steps.

- Tramlines has completed the vendor form (received 5/1).
- DocuSign MPA envelope sent to Alex on 5/1; I see it completed and signed this morning — saving signed copy as trm_mpa_signed_docusign.pdf.
- Finance (cc'd) confirms they can accept invoices without a PO if Procurement issues an exception memo and we limit to $25k and 30 days. Finance will require the invoice to include: "Redwood Dept: Sales - Pilot Trials" as a department code and the HubSpot Deal ID in the invoice memo to help reconciliation.

Karthik — can you publish the exception memo to the vendor file (I can attach to the HubSpot deal record) and confirm approval language? Once that's done I will tell Tramlines to submit the first invoice and route to finance@redwood.com.

Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround on the paperwork. We'll get you spun up today once procurement attaches the memo.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
